Listening, backup, recovery and private reports

Online search and playback contact external music services. They receive your requests and network address. Public results can include covers and different recordings; check the title and source before saving.
Google Drive is optional. Review the backup choices before connecting or restoring. A library backup does not automatically include audio files; keep your own copies of imported music.

If something fails, retry the affected action. App health keeps playback recovery, diagnostics and version details available. Advanced storage tools and the classic interface remain available in You. Uninstalling or clearing app data can remove local music and library data.

Preview diagnostics before sharing. Remove private titles, paths and account details. Report security or privacy issues privately to jayednahian2002@gmail.com; never post credentials or private recordings in public issues.
